items.description: FeaturesArcade high score chasing gameplayPleasing 3D visuals16 level campaign with procedural customer ordersEndless mode for both small and large level layouts with procedural customer orders6 randomly occurring hazards to challenge you8 useful Assists to overcome hazards 3 special level types to add even more challenge and strangeness Catchy original musicClick and Collect challenges you to serve as many customers as possible within a time limit to earn the maximum 3 stars on each level and keep your customers happy in your store.It starts off easy enough, you just need to provide customers with their orders, grabbing the boxes from the conveyor belt and passing them to the correct customer. Before long, however, things get more hectic. Electrical malfunctions, fires, puddles, thieves, and your manager are hazards to your efficiency and threaten to ruin your customer service.Help is at handClick and Collect features 8 Assists you can purchase with in-game currency to help you manage your customer’s orders. A speed boost gives you that extra spring in your step to get to items and customers quicker. Boots allow you to stroll through puddles without slipping and dropping anything you’re carrying. A fire-proof suit grants resistant to fire for you and anything you’re holding. A mechanic can be summoned to keep your conveyor belt running at the correct speed. The manager’s schedule can be utilised to prevent your manager stepping out onto the shopfloor and berating you if you get too close. A security guard can be summoned to scare away any thieves who mean to steal away customer’s orders. A generator can be utilised to keep the lights on during any power cuts. Finally, a special Assist that clears all obstacles can be used when things get tricky.That’s strange…Strange occurrences also threaten to make your quest for customer satisfaction more difficult. Time dilation, random teleportation, bouts of memory loss in customers, these add an extra level of challenge to overcome UnpredictableWith procedurally generated customer orders and randomly occurring hazards, Click and Collect is a hectic and compelling arcade, strategy action game that keeps you on your toes throughout the 16 standard levels and 4 Endless levels. Keeping a healthy supply of Assists ready to use, and strategising about what customer orders to prioritise is an engaging challenge. items.description: This is a game with numbers. By clicking on the button you accumulate a certain currency - clicks. Invest the accumulated amount in the effectiveness of each subsequent click and also get auto-click. Each improvement is worth a certain number of clicks. Thus, the more you spend on improvements, the faster and more you gain in the future. Not only clicks are tracked, but clicks are calculated per second. A kind of performance rating. A feature of the game is the so-called offline auto-click. While you are not in the game, your clicks continue to accumulate. - Accumulate clicks even when not playing. items.description: Take control of your own racing drone and fly through a range of hand-crafted environments, each with enemies to race against and fire missiles at. An intuitive control scheme allows you to fly your drone surprisingly easily whether you use mouse and keyboard or controller, and the game's aesthetic but simple low poly style allows you to focus on going as fast as possible. You've raced on a track in 2 dimensions so many times already - are you ready to race in 3D? This is a game that allows you to become really skilled in the flying mechanics. They take a while to pick up, but it's very rewarding when you master control of your drone and are able to fly almost impossible-looking lines easily. The game has full rebindable controls so you can control the game your way.
